OTA-1853 — the ring learns who, not just when (diagnostics only)

Baker #3's owner-device capture (iPhone SE, 2026-09-19) measured a real
memory ratchet — baseline 951MB, peak 1903MB, seven retained steps, +675MB
that never came back, 98.3% of it in the default malloc zone across
4.42-4.45M live blocks — and the forensic pass ruled OUTCOME C, HOLDER NOT
PROVEN. Two reasons, both addressed here, neither of them a memory fix.

1. THE COMPOSER THREW THE EVIDENCE AWAY. The recorder took 504 samples into
   a 512-slot ring with `evicted 0` and the report printed the last 48. All
   seven steps happened before that window opened. REPORT_SAMPLE_ROWS 48->512,
   REPORT_EVENT_ROWS 32->64. Measured cost: 4,789 -> 49,729 chars. The block
   rides buildBasicDeviceSummary, beside the log body rather than inside it,
   so the 200,000-char full-log cap does not touch it; the transport chunks at
   7,500 raw chars and a 405,000-char send is already proven on hardware.

2. THE VOCABULARY WAS BLIND TO THE SUSPECTS. The 49-second window carrying
   every step held THIRTEEN room transitions and seven `roster=new` events,
   and MEM_KIND had words only for Qwen, MiniLM, voice, touches and
   persistence. Kinds 90-125 name rooms, routes, scenes, rosters, artwork and
   audio players; memCodeForId is a pure 16-bit FNV-1a with no map, so the
   instrument cannot become the holder it was installed to find.

THE REPORT NOW DOES THE JOIN. Retained steps are detected at compose time and
printed with the annotated events recorded inside each one, before the raw
rows. That is CO-LOCATION IN TIME AND NOTHING MORE: the section names no
holder and no cause, and H5 tests that those words never appear in it.

DETECTOR DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED. detectRatchetSteps measured the settle floor
with floorAt(settleAt), whose 10-sample lookback reaches back THROUGH the rise
when settle is only 8 samples past it. That rejected the first genuine
candidate and re-found the same step nine samples later — ~2.25s at device
cadence, which is the whole event-join window, so a late-dated step is
attributed to whatever happened after its cause. The settle floor is now the
minimum from the rise onward, and a rise with no room left to settle is left
open rather than claimed.

THE GAME IS UNCHANGED. Nine non-comment lines reach production files: three
imports and six diagnostic calls. Exactly one line was removed — ArtFlash's
`return clearTimer;`, replaced by a closure that still calls it first, proven
by rendering the real component against a fake clock. Nothing frees, disposes,
caches, loads, navigates or reschedules anything.

gameStore.ts IS NOT TOUCHED. It stands at exactly its 36815-line ceiling, a
deliberate anti-growth ratchet, so the room boundary is observed from outside
the store rather than spending a permanent allowance on a temporary probe.
The observer keys transitions on the id STRING and reports the hash, so a
16-bit collision can cost an ambiguous label but never a missing crossing.
Measured: 374ns per unchanged store publish (760ns before the string check),
and 200,000 unchanged publishes emit zero events.

TWO EXISTING PINS WENT STALE AND WERE REPAIRED, NOT WEAKENED.
- ota1433ChoiceArtFlash pinned the teardown by its exact source text. The
  claim is unchanged and still asserted (the teardown clears the timer FIRST);
  only the spelling moved, and the behaviour is now additionally proven by
  J5/J6 rendering the real component.
- ota1484APinStatesAClaim's shrink-only fixture ratchet 52 -> 54, following
  its own documented procedure: both new sites fall in the class it already
  names ("minimal argument objects for pure predicates"), said at both sites
  and at the ratchet. onStoreChange reads the location id as an opaque string
  and never resolves a cell, so placedAt would import world geometry into a
  test about string identity; the second site is deliberately malformed.

NATIVE REMAINDER, written down before the next capture rather than after:
phase reads `unknown` on every sample and it is NOT a JS decode bug (every JS
link traced and holds), so no OTA fixes it; no subsystem identity on a malloc
block; task_vm_info read for phys_footprint only. None of the three blocks
this pass.

VALIDATION on the exact committed tree: full surface 1358/1358 suites,
15,751 passed, 0 failed. 22/22 local gates. typecheck:ci and lint clean.
Ten negative controls each red then restored byte-identical, including one
that reintroduces the detector defect above and one that drops clearTimer.

NOT CLAIMED: no holder is identified, nothing is repaired, and no capture has
been taken on hardware with this build.
